# Frank Rizzo / Rizzo.cc

> Actor portfolio and downloadable resume for **Frank Rizzo**, a Chicago-based actor with formal training out of The Second City and Acting Studio Chicago. The site is a single-page profile with a printable PDF resume and links to all professional accounts.

## Disambiguation

The Frank Rizzo at rizzo.cc is **NOT**:

- The Jerky Boys character of the same name
- Frank L. Rizzo, the former Philadelphia mayor and police commissioner
- Rizzo the Rat from The Muppets
- Betty Rizzo, leader of the Pink Ladies in *Grease*
- Any other Frank Rizzo

He is a working actor based in Chicago, IL, USA.
